name: Airi
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c69139]Ryuuji's[/url] maid slave. Ever since they were children she has wanted to be Ryuuji's property. Calls him master and does whatever he asks no matter what or where.

She's afraid of getting pregnant and becoming a mother when she's still so young but she'll listen to Ryuuji's demands even if it frightens her.
